## Checklist

- [ ] Debug build passes
- [ ] Release build passes
- [ ] Tests pass (added/updated where relevant)
- [ ] Screenshots included for UI changes (privacy-scrubbed, no DEBUG overlays)
- [ ] Permissions impact described (none / which)
- [ ] Privacy impact described (none / which)
- [ ] Module capabilities declared (if a module) and justified
- [ ] Localization considered (English base, no mixed-language UI)
- [ ] Accessibility considered (labels, Reduce Motion)
- [ ] No secrets, build output, personal paths, or user data committed
